decisions.reason: The SPI MOSI reassignment to GPIO47 does not change the distinct GPIO5-controlled 5V rail.
The available-GPIO list and SPI MOSI reassignment do not alter the standalone USB 3.3V power path.
The source decision changes an MCU signal assignment, not AXP2101 power-management behavior or system rails.
Reassigning SPI MOSI does not change DCDC1 voltage, current rating, or normal-operation role.
The source message does not change the battery connector's type, pinout, placement, or accessibility.
The SPI MOSI reassignment has no effect on battery cutoff or thermal-protection requirements.
The source decision concerns SPI MOSI and does not change the charge-status LED circuit or connector.
The addressable LED interface remains controlled by GPIO5 and is unaffected by moving SPI MOSI to GPIO47.
SPI MOSI is not part of the recorded J_PWR_SIGNAL pinout, so the interboard signal interface remains unchanged.
The MCU GPIO reassignment does not alter the power board's dimensions, orientation, mounting, or connector placement.
The necessary SPI MOSI reassignment and candidate GPIO pool are already fully represented by the candidate's existing message-304 MODIFY Event.
The GPIO reassignment does not change the deferred requirement for assembly-ready BOM part numbers.
